verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no INPI page documenting public API endpoints, a key-issuance process, or rate limits; the docs cover filing procedures, guidance and a general database-search mention. The single probe saw a keyless HTTP 403 on data.inpi.fr, which suggests token-gated access but is not first-party documentation of an API. A public data API is a fair axis for an IP office, so absence of evidence is "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
